selection: per crop x horizon, lowest validation MAE among ['trailing_median_4w', 'ewma_a05', 'drift_4w']; advances only if its market-cluster skill interval at level 1 - 0.05/27 has lower bound > 0; else persistence-only
acceptance: an advanced method is accepted for a cell only if, on the test window: (1) market-cluster skill interval at level 1 - 0.05/k (k = number of advanced cells) has lower bound > 0; (2) the state-cluster 95% interval has lower bound > 0; (3) the skill stays > 0 when any one state is left out. Otherwise persistence remains the forecast
test_gate: run once, only when the dataset covers the last test target week and was retrieved >= 10 days after it (late records, D-56 revision log); RUN_LOCK.json is created before any test row is read
data: candidate-prices-v1.2 or a later version built with unchanged rules; versions are named in the run manifest
